Subject: Discrepancy in Nov settlements: unapplied credits showing in AR

Hi Aisha,

We were reconciling our November settlements and noticed several credit notes we issued (credit_note_8372.pdf attached) landed in Redwood's AR as unapplied credits rather than being applied to the matching invoices. The CSV (CR_InvoiceBatch_Nov.csv) highlights 12 rows where the credit references an RDW invoice number but the VAT flags and invoice series don't match the entries in your ledger (some invoices are in "RDW-INV-2026" series, others in "RDW-INV-2027").

Key symptoms: 
- Our balance shows as a customer credit, but your AR shows the underlying invoices still open.
- VAT treatment on our side was standard EU tax (20%) but the credit was posted with a different VAT code.

Can you confirm receipt and let us know whether Redwood will: (a) reapply the credits to the intended invoices, (b) issue a journal correction on your side, or (c) require us to reissue the credit?

Elena

Thanks for the ping — dug into the CSV and ledger. Summary of findings:

- Root cause: credit_note_8372 referenced invoice series RDW-INV-2026 but the credits were applied using the import mapping that only matches RDW-INV-2027 patterns (regex mismatch). The mapping step silently created unapplied credit lines instead of linking to open invoices.
- VAT mismatch: CloudResellCo's credit uses EU VAT 20% code; our import pipeline earlier this month defaulted to an exempt VAT code for that reseller due to an upstream vendor file change. That prevented the normal match by amount + VAT code.
- Impact: 12 credit lines totaling EUR 112,450 are sitting in unapplied credits — AR aging for CloudResellCo shows higher outstanding balances than the customer expects.

Proposed remediation:
1) Create reversal JEs for the unapplied credit postings to pull them out of suspense (CR suspense account).
2) Re-run the mapping/apply script with updated regex & VAT mapping.
3) Post corrected application JEs that move amounts to proper invoice receivables and adjust VAT tax payable accounts.
4) Produce an audit memo and attach CR_InvoiceBatch_Nov.csv + JE support (je-supporting-entries.xlsx).

I can prepare the JEs and the apply script patch. Need Marissa's sign-off for posting the reversing and applying JEs (tax reclass impacts tax payable). If approved, estimate 2 business days to complete and 1 day to validate with CloudResellCo.

Connor O'Brien
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
